collection_method.strategy: Balanced collection across both newest and most_relevant review sorts and rating filters 1 through 5, followed by deduplication and balanced selection into the final raw dataset.

cleaning_decisions: Removed duplicate reviews using normalized raw review text for deduplication.
Removed extremely short reviews with fewer than 3 words after cleaning.
Stripped simple HTML tags if present.
Expanded common contractions before punctuation removal to preserve meaning, especially negation.
Removed emojis, punctuation, URLs, email addresses, and other special characters.
Removed a light stop-word set to preserve more of the original phrasing.
Applied relaxed lemmatization to reduce over-stemming and keep cleaned text readable for grouping and persona work.
